name: 16th Street Station
heritage: National Register of Historic Places listed place
text: 16th Street station (Oakland Central) is a former Southern Pacific Railroad station in the Prescott neighborhood of Oakland, California, United States. The Beaux-Arts building was designed by architect Jarvis Hunt, a preeminent railroad station architect, and opened in 1912. The station has not been served by trains since 1994.

depictions.text: 16th Street Station is a World Location in Watch Dogs 2.
